events.title: WebKit open-sourced by Apple
events.summary: Apple open-sourced [WebKit] on June 7, 2005 at [WWDC] — releasing the [Safari] rendering engine that began as a KHTML fork.
events.about: Open [WebKit] let other projects embed Apple's engine without starting from scratch. Nokia used it in mobile browsers; Google chose it for [Chrome] in 2008. Today [Blink] ([Chrome]'s fork) and [WebKit] ([Safari]) together power most of the world's browsing.

narrative.whyChosen: Open-sourcing [WebKit] was the decision that enabled [Chrome] and modern mobile browsers.
narrative.whyImportant: It turned Apple's engine into shared infrastructure for the entire industry.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers building browsers or embedded web views needed a modern, licensable engine beyond [IE] and Gecko.
